title: ISB Security Platform: Active Development
intro: The ISB Security Platform is in active development.
ISB Security Solutions is building a unified platform for professional security operations, reporting, personnel planning and site management.
The development platform includes operational workspaces, patrol and reporting workflows, personnel and assignment management, and customer and object hierarchy management.
Role-based access, company-scoped data handling and selected offline reporting and patrol workflows form part of the technical foundation.
AI-assisted reporting, operational integration and broader environment validation remain under development.
The platform has not been announced as commercially available or production-validated. No public release date has been established.
